entities.summary: Carlos Luis Rivero Milán is a Venezuelan former professional baseball third baseman. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Tokyo Yakult Swallows.
